Thanks again for the time today — great discussion on the pilot goals and how you
plan to measure success. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Success criteria: 3 internal teams running >500 inference calls/day each OR 50k tokens/day total,
  with <250ms median latency for the 2 main prompt types.
- Trial duration: 30 days starting on the day you flip billing (we can start earlier if you prefer).
- Procurement: you mentioned Procurement prefers PO versus card; please confirm the contact and any SLA/insurance
  requirements.
- Marketplace: you were evaluating buying through your cloud marketplace — you said you'll check with procurement.

Action items:
1) Lisa: confirm procurement contact and whether PO is required (cc procurement if helpful).
2) Marissa: share trial success metrics doc and SOW draft for procurement review.
3) Marissa: confirm billing start options (start-of-trial vs conversion-to-paid).

Attaching: Redwood_trial-success-metrics.xlsx (success criteria + recommended telemetry)
Also attaching a SOW template we typically use for procurement review.

If PO is preferred, we can route a minimal SOW + invoice and accept a PO to bridge the trial to paid conversion.
Let me know if a short procurement packet would be helpful and I'll send a compact version.

Best,

Thanks Tanya — appreciate the clarity. I've prepared the compact packet and attached: one-page SOW, invoice stub, and our W-9.

A few clarifications so procurement has options for the PO flow:
- Option A (preferred by Acme per call): issue PO, Redwood activates trial environment immediately upon PO receipt and we start the 30-day trial on activation date.
- Option B: start trial now on credit card; upon conversion to paid we accept a PO for the committed reserved capacity and apply the invoice.

Trial-to-paid conversion checks we recommend including in the SOW packet:
- Usage threshold: either X = 50k tokens/day aggregate OR Y = 3 apps >500 calls/day (whichever hits first).
- Successful run of two representative prompts with <250ms median latency across test window.
- Team signoff: product lead + platform lead confirm data quality and performance.

If procurement prefers Option A, please share an expected PO issue date (Tanya) and the billing contact. If Option B, we can enable card billing and delay PO paperwork until conversion.

I've cc'd our finance and legal contacts for speed. If helpful, I can also send a DocuSign link for a minimal SOW acceptance to speed PO issuance.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
